listing.name: Perfect Dark / Perfect Dark Dab's Mod (DabDavis)
listing.summary: Use the complete Dab’s Mod Windows player with your own Perfect Dark USA Rev 1 original. Preserve its actual save root and expanded formats; upstream owns updates and any restarted game.

steps.title: Prepare this fork’s original and complete player
steps.instruction: Use a complete permitted Dab’s Mod Windows copy. The individually inspected v3.15.1 ZIP contains x64 pd.x86_64.exe, SDL2.dll, zlib1.dll and a data folder; keep them together. Supply your own Perfect Dark USA Rev 1 / NTSC-final / US v1.1 big-endian ROM as data/pd.ntsc-final.z64. Upstream identifies MD5 e03b088b6ac9e0080440efed07c1e40f; PAL and Japanese originals are not this fork’s supported input. The ZIP does not supply the ROM. Keep this fork distinct from the stock managed Perfect Dark port.

steps.title: Select normal native play
steps.instruction: After upstream preparation, select pd.x86_64.exe, use its complete containing folder as working directory and leave arguments empty for the documented normal route. Preserve an already established --basedir, --savedir, --portable or mod-directory choice as separate literal arguments instead of changing its data roots during attachment. Do not attach an updater, standalone replacement download or another fork’s executable.

steps.title: Back up the effective save directory before startup
steps.instruction: In the selected source, --savedir overrides the save root; --portable uses the executable directory. Otherwise a writable executable directory becomes the save root and can copy older saves into it when pd.ini is absent. An unwritable installation can retain the legacy working-directory or per-user fallback. Keep every actual old and current root, pd.ini, EEPROM, player/progress files, Combat Simulator setups, mods, added content, screenshots, recordings and upstream backups. The startup log names the effective base/save directories; preserve any custom paths independently. A package-folder copy alone is not a complete backup when a different root is active.

steps.title: Keep expanded saves with compatible versions
steps.instruction: Ordinary stock-format setups can remain readable by the stock port, but setups with more than eight simulants and moved-stat formats need compatible versions. Returning to an older executable does not convert or rewind those files. Preserve the whole creating runtime and data before switching channels, mods or versions; no cross-version or stock/fork save conversion is qualified.

steps.title: Finish upstream updates outside the attached session
steps.instruction: Dab’s Mod can stage and replace its executable and restart it. On Windows the restart starts a successor and lets the selected process exit; Portcove does not adopt or terminate that successor. Close the actual restarted game before maintenance, review/relink changed selected bytes, then start a new Play session. Keep optional online, account, recording and added-content actions as your own separate upstream choices.

steps.title: Keep external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the selected executable, working folder and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. You and upstream own preparation, runtime replacement, recovery and all external files. Close every actual player and companion before maintenance, retain independent complete working copies and data, then review/relink changed executable bytes. Removing registration preserves external files; Portcove does not offer external update, backup, rollback, migration, conversion or deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy, components and originals you are permitted to use. Bounded package/PE inspection and owned-probe controls do not establish native gameplay, real-save compatibility, installed Desktop, other-platform or Supported acceptance.
